message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "R&D Intensity Change", "construction": "Change in R&D expenditure over the past year, scaled by beginning-of-year total assets. Data from Compustat: (R&D_t - R&D_{t-1}) / Assets_{t-1}.", "rationale": "Firms increasing R&D investment may have better growth prospects not yet fully priced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Debt Surge", "construction": "Percentage increase in short-term debt (Compustat: Data item 34) over the past fiscal year.", "rationale": "Sudden increases in short-term borrowing might signal liquidity needs or aggressive expansion, potentially leading to higher future returns if those bets succeed.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "One-year change in inventory turnover ratio: (COGS / Average Inventory)_{t} - (COGS / Average Inventory)_{t-1}.", "rationale": "Improving inventory turnover may indicate operational improvements or increasing demand, both of which can foreshadow higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Insider Net Purchase Ratio", "construction": "Net number of shares acquired by insiders over the past year, divided by shares outstanding. Source: SEC insider filings.", "rationale": "Insider buying may reflect management’s confidence in future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Non-Operating Income Share", "construction": "Proportion of pre-tax income from non-operating sources (non-operating income / pre-tax income, Compustat items 13/170).", "rationale": "A high share may signal low earnings quality and risk of negative surprises.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Unexpected Dividend Initiations", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to 1 if the firm paid a dividend this year but none in the prior three years, 0 otherwise.", "rationale": "Surprise dividend initiations may signal management’s confidence in sustainable cash flows.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Count Growth", "construction": "Percentage change in the number of US patents granted (USPTO data) in the last three years relative to the prior three years.", "rationale": "Rapid innovation, as evidenced by patenting activity, may foreshadow future profitability and returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Related-Party Transactions Ratio", "construction": "Dollar value of disclosed related-party transactions (from annual report footnotes) divided by total assets.", "rationale": "High levels may indicate potential agency conflicts and lower future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Auditor Tenure Change", "construction": "Binary variable: 1 if auditor changed in the past fiscal year, 0 otherwise (from proxy statements).", "rationale": "Recent auditor changes may signal forthcoming accounting restatements or firm-specific shocks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Post-Listing Return Reversal", "construction": "Cumulative abnormal return in months 7-12 after IPO or exchange listing (adjusted for market return).", "rationale": "Initial post-listing overreaction may reverse, providing higher returns to laggard stocks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}]}
